summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting its intention to offer $275 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031 in a private placement under Rule 144A. The offering includes a $225 million base tranche, a $25 million greenshoe option, and up to $50 million in affiliate notes to Double Zero Capital, LP. Net proceeds will fund development of the Cariboo Gold Project and general corporate purposes. The company will enter cash-settled capped call transactions to offset dilution. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms are disclosed.
